definitions.explanation: A short written record or reminder.

examples.english: I'll write it down in my notes.

examples.japanese: メモを{見|み}ながら{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: I explained while looking at my notes.

notes:
メモ is an abbreviation from English 'memorandum' and refers to short notes or reminders.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- メモを{取|と}る (take notes)
- メモする (to make a note)
- メモに{残|のこ}す (leave in notes)
- メモを{見|み}る (look at notes)

TYPES OF NOTES:
- メモ{帳|ちょう} (memo pad, notebook)
- メモ{用紙|ようし} (memo paper)
- {付箋|ふせん}メモ (sticky note)
- ボイスメモ (voice memo)

DIGITAL:
- メモアプリ (notes app)
- スマホのメモ (phone notes)

RELATED WORDS:
- ノート (notebook)
- {覚|おぼ}え{書|が}き (memorandum, note)
- {筆記|ひっき} (note-taking)
- {記録|きろく} (record)
